title: Candid or Traditional Wedding Photography?
description: What candid, documentary and traditional actually mean on a wedding quote, and which one leaves you with the photographs you were imagining.
og_image_alt: Comparing candid and traditional wedding photography

article.headline: Candid or traditional? What those words mean in a quote
article.standfirst: Every studio in India now advertises candid photography, which has made the word almost useless. Here is how to work out what you are actually being sold.
